correctness.rationale: For g_c(t)=(t-c)e^(-beta t^2) at ab=1/2, Zak-frame criterion reduces frame positivity to noncoincident zeros of two theta entries; theta function has one simple zero per period parallelogram and a ratio difference elliptic function with two simple zeros only at u=0,1/2, at which P/F=0. Hence simultaneous fibre zero iff c=0 for every width and rectangular aspect ratio, including pure-Gaussian endpoint. At beta=pi,a=1/2,b=1 the Hessian of the unique zero fibre is nondegenerate; minimizing the quadratic Taylor form yields C_R=Delta^2/||u||^2, C_I=Delta^2/||v||^2. Reflection g_(-c)(-t)=-g_c(t) makes optimal A(c) even and real analytic near zero, so odd total degrees vanish and remainder is O(|c|^4). Direct independent Gaussian tail summation gave C_R=1.999916096270648 and C_I=.4881512351938045. Infinite conclusion uses theta argument principle and implicit function theorem, not finite sampling.
